definition: ἄ-τοπος, -ον (τόπος), [in LXX: Job.4:8 11:11, Pro.30:20, al., for אָוֶן, etc. ;] __1. out of place, not befitting.  __2. marvellous, strange (of symptoms, Hipp.): Act.28:6; hence, in late Greek, with ethical sense,  __3. improper, unrighteous (so in LXX, and for exx. from π., see M, Th., l.with; MM, see word): Luk.23:41, Act.25:5, 2Th.3:2.† (AS)
